newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai exports in January rise 5.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai exports in January rise 5.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Tuesday the country's exports in January rose by 5.1 percent year on year.
"The export growth in January was satisfactory because we had minus (export) growth for the last seven to eight months," Amnuay told reporters.
He was speaking after meeting with Bank of Thailand officials to review the country's monthly economic indicators.
Amnuay said Thai foreign reserves in February would be about $38 billion compared with $39.2 billion in January.

He denied reports that Thai foreign reserve had fallen sharply to about 37 billion baht ($1.42 billion) because the central bank had used funds to defend the baht from speculative attack earlier this year.
The minister said most other key monthly economic indicators had shown an improving trend, but he declined to give exact figures.
The BOT is scheduled to release key monthly economic data tomorrow.
